Lawrence, KS · Gravel

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no riders left behind before the first pit stop. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @thesundaychug the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Sunday Chug group ride

A weekly gravel ride out of Sunflower in downtown Lawrence. It usually rolls at 8:30, with an early or late option depending on season and weather. Nobody gets left before the first pit stop, where the shop provides water, coffee and gels. There's a free bike wash at the shop after. Routes are on the Strava club.
